messages:
anya: heads up — while bringing up orion-2.1-int8 on staging we see weird bracket/rtl placement with zh/ja + arabic mixed text. small repro below.

anya: input: `中文（括号） and العربية(قوس)`
anya: stdout from orion-2.1-int8: `中文）括号（ and العربية)قوس(` — brackets swapped and parens moved across scripts.

kai: wow that's nasty. does float32 baseline behave?

anya: float32 baseline (orion-2.1 fp32) => `中文（括号） and العربية(قوس)` — correct.

matt: looks like tokenization or detokenization step after quant changes. maybe ZWJ/ZWNJ or bidi markers getting dropped.

hao: can you paste the raw token ids + detok step? maybe a join order flip in the detokenizer when bidi heuristic triggers.

anya: pasted snippet from eval harness:
```
# token ids (truncated)
[2345, 98765, 123, 40012, 77, 99877, 300]
# detok fp32:
"中文（括号） and العربية(قوس)"
# detok int8:
"中文）括号（ and العربية)قوس("
```

kai: eval-bot please run langpair tests for zh-ar with punctuation-heavy sentences and return BLEU/chrF deltas between fp32 and int8. @eval-bot

eval-bot: queued tests: zh->ar, ar->zh, ja->ar, zh->ja. will post diffs in ~15m.

matt: also check tokenization boundary around fullwidth parens U+FF08/U+FF09 vs ASCII parens. mixing scripts can trigger bidi embedding changes.

anya: quick local diff: replacing U+FF08/FF09 with ASCII () in input fixed output order on int8. so maybe unicode normalization step behaving differently under quantized tokenizer weights.

hao: could be a model-side regression where the special-case normalization token embedding or prefix cache path changes when using int8 kernels. worth bisecting quant config (symmetric vs per-channel, clipping, kernel combo).

kai: for on-call next steps: 1) add regression test covering mixed zh+ar brackets and emojis, 2) run int8 variants w/ and w/o unicode-normalize preproc, 3) run token-level diff logging in the runtime, 4) assign to eng-ml quant owner.

anya: i'll add test and a short repro script to staging harness. putting a temporary alert if BLEU/chrF drop >0.5 for these pairs.

matt: ping me once you have token-level logs, i'll help bisect kernels. thanks :thumbsup:

eval-bot: results: zh->ar chrF: fp32=47.3 int8=45.1 (delta -2.2), ja->ar chrF delta -1.8, ar->zh delta -0.9. attaching full diffs to the test run (link: https://ci.local/redwood/evals/2187612345).

anya: rough conclusion: int8 path introduces reorder on mixed-script bracket tokens. prioritizing fix for dedicated and hosted rollouts.

kai: good triage. assign to @matt and @hao for kernel + detok follow-up. i'll add to next eng-ml sprint.

anya: thanks — will update thread with repro PR and test link.
